Psalm 23 Transportation began with a shared calling to build something together. We’re a family-owned business founded by Isabella, her boyfriend, and her dad, with God at the center of it all.

Our name is a reminder of who leads us. Our work is an opportunity to serve others with care, honest communication, and a commitment to the job in front of us.
